metrics.labels: NEW states (LIBERO sampler on K1's BDDL, seeds 920000 + k, none equal to an SR 50-62 state), main k = 4-63 (60), branches seed_base 38000000 + 1000 k; layout O; tasks K1, K2, N1, N2; client seed 7, --bind track.  Models and arms: frozen pi0.5 (pp_serve_purify --model pi05 --mode intact --comp= --seed 13): I, H (SR 62's arm, s2fix2.py client --arm H unchanged), Hp (H with perception: OWLv2 boxes + rendered depth + camera calibration for the held mug's identity and the target plate's position; ProprioHeld for the hold); frozen pi0 (serve_guided --mode ours --seed 13, BACKBONE_CONFIG=pi0_libero) and frozen GR00T (pp_serve_purify --model groot --mode intact --comp= --seed 13): I and H.  Success = the BDDL goal.  Matrices [task, state].  Paired bootstrap over states, tasks fixed (s2.boot2_states, B = 2000, numpy default_rng(0); CI = 2.5 / 97.5).  Label rule (SR 62): for arm X against I, dN = X - I on N1+N2, dK = X - I on K1+K2; FIX WORKS iff dN lo > 0 AND dK lo > -.05 (NON-INFERIOR at margin -.05); PARTIAL iff exactly one holds; FAILS iff neither.  PRIMARY (pi0.5): the label of Hp.  PERCEPTION COST (pi0.5): Hp - H pooled over the four tasks, and on N1+N2 and K1+K2: PERCEPTION COSTS iff hi < 0; PERCEPTION GAINS iff lo > 0; else NO CLEAR DIFFERENCE.  CROSS-MODEL: per model (pi0.5, pi0, GR00T) the label of H; SR 50's floor: a model is TESTABLE iff its intact (I) K1+K2 success >= .70 on these states; a NOT TESTABLE model's label is reported as NOT TESTABLE with the rule's outcome descriptive.  SECONDARY: SR 54's rule for every hand-over arm (FIXED iff X - I on N1+N2 lo > 0 and X >= .50; NOT FIXED iff hi < .10; else PARTIAL).  PERCEPTION ACCURACY (Hp, against the simulator oracle, logged only): target plate registration error (xy, z; cm) and side correct (the registered point nearer the instructed plate than the other plate); mug identity at registration; at every detector onset, perceived held mug = the simulator rule's held mug (share, s2cue.boot_share over states) and gate decision = the decision H's rule makes on the same step; first-onset agreement per task.  C1: the reference planner (s2.plan_episode, unchanged) on the main states; MET iff its N1-N2 success >= .80.  Descriptive: gate decisions, P phases and aborts, final plate of each mug.
metrics.perception:
(this file, `client --arm Hp`): H with every simulator read replaced.
  - Hold events: ProprioHeld, unchanged (proprioception only).
  - Detector: OWLv2 (where.OwlDetector's checkpoint google/owlv2-base-patch16-ensemble, the repo's off-the-shelf open-vocabulary
    detector), run in a sidecar (s2fix3_det.py, openpi venv) on the agentview RGB image the policy receives (256 px, before the
    224 resize), queries "a white mug", "a yellow and white mug", "a red mug", "a plate".  Mug boxes (ASSIGN = perm): the three best
    boxes by max mug-query score (>= MIN_SCORE, IoU < .3), then the query-to-box permutation maximising the sum of each query's
    score relative to its best of the three.  (pcheck's greedy assignment swapped the white and yellow-and-white mug; pcheck2
    chose perm on development states.)  Plates: the two best "a plate" boxes (IoU < .3).
  - 3-D: rg.py rgp's remaining privilege, unchanged in kind: the rendered agentview depth (sc_pu.depth_std) back-projected through the
    camera calibration (sc_pu.cam_model) -> the median world point of each box's inner half -> + a per-type constant (CAL, fitted by
    mode `pcheck` on DEVELOPMENT states only: SR 62's states k 0-63, never this probe's states).
  - Target plate: registered ONCE at the first gated step (n = WAIT), as rgp (paper C.6), no tracking afterwards.  "left" / "right"
    from the instruction picks the detected plate on that side by SIDE_RULE (fixed by `pcheck` on development states).
  - Held mug at an onset: OWLv2 re-run on that step's image; mug positions = this detection, falling back per mug to its last
    detected position (registration at n = WAIT, then every onset); the held mug = the nearest within HELD_R of the proprioceptive
    hand position.  Same gate rule as H.  P = SR 54's P with the registered target position in place of the simulator's.
  - The simulator oracle (positions, H's held-mug rule and decision on the same step) is LOGGED in the side file, never fed.
